fuel_consumption.source_quote: Item 7A section content does not isolate fuel hedging quantitative disclosures. No fuel hedging program disclosed for FY ended March 31, 2002; hedging program established November 2002 per subsequent filing.

instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program for FY ended March 31, 2002. Per the FY2003 filing, Frontier implemented a fuel hedging program in November 2002 (after this fiscal year end). Item 7A section was very large combined file but fuel hedging disclosures not found via keyword search.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel costs of $61,226,000 for 70,530,000 gallons used and $71,083,000 for 66,724,000 gallons used resulted in an average fuel cost of 87¢ and $1.07 per gallon for the years ended March 31, 2002 and 2001.

warnings: Fuel hedging program was established in November 2002, after the March 31, 2002 fiscal year end.
